lines.en: label toukadorm10:
I knock on Touka’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲开 Touka 的门，等她应声。

lines.en: Immediately upon knocking, however, I am graced by the suspicious sound of laughter.
lines.zh: 可刚一敲，我就被一阵可疑的笑声「款待」了。

lines.en: Now, laughter on its own isn’t really something I’d ever call suspicious.
lines.zh: 本来，光听笑声，我不会觉得有什么可疑。

lines.en: But I want to remind you exactly where I am right now, and exactly who it is that resides behind this door.
lines.zh: 但我要提醒你：我现在站在哪儿，这扇门后住的又是谁。

lines.en: Could it be that Touka and Yasu’s friendship has finally reached a point where they both understand {i}and{/i} leisurely banter with one another?
lines.zh: 难不成 Touka 和 Yasu 的友情终于到了能互相理解、{i}还{/i}能悠闲斗嘴的地步？

lines.en: Is Yasu even capable of such a thing?
lines.zh: Yasu 真有这本事吗？

lines.en: Or...is this occasion truly a suspicious one after all?
lines.zh: 还是说……这次的动静其实真有点可疑？

lines.en: Seeing as there is no answer, I take it upon myself to enter anyway as this is a matter I must investigate to ensure the safety of both my students and myself.
lines.zh: 见没人应，我自做主推进了门——这事我必须查个水落石出，好确保我的学生和我本人的安全。

lines.en: scene black
I’m sure I’m probably just overcomplicating things by thinking something is afoot here, but that sort of thing happens all the time when I’m standing outside of doors.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定我只是想多了、把这儿当成「有事发生」了，但我站在门外时老这样。

lines.en: It’s just a habit, I guess- envisioning what’s on the other side.
lines.zh: 大概就是种习惯——脑补门后是什么。

lines.en: What could go wrong.
lines.zh: 会出什么岔子。

lines.en: What could go right.
lines.zh: 会有什么好事。

lines.en: scene toukahair1
But, on most occasions, definitely wrong.
lines.zh: 不过大多数时候，绝对是岔子。

lines.en: : Oh my. Could it be that you’ve wandered into the incorrect room, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你该不会是走错房间了，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yes. {i}Could it be that you’ve wandered into the incorrect room, Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : 对。{i}你该不会是走错房间了，Sensei？{/i}

lines.en: : Touka, that hurts.
lines.zh: : Touka，你这话伤人了。

lines.en: : Shut up and deal with the pain, Yasu. It wouldn’t hurt so much if you would actually brush your hair every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，忍着，Yasu。你要是肯偶尔梳梳头，就不会这么疼了。

lines.en: : Okay, Touka. I will do as you say as long as it means I can have beautiful hair like yours one day.
lines.zh: : 好的，Touka。我照你说的做，只要将来有一天能有你那样漂亮的头发。

lines.en: : I suppose there is no harm in dreaming.
lines.zh: : 做做梦倒也无妨。

lines.en: : Hey, Tsubasa. I didn’t realize you were going to be here.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsubasa。我不知道你也在这儿。

lines.en: : The same goes for me. I didn’t believe you were even permitted to enter the girls’ dormitories. But I suppose I’m not very well acquainted with the rules of public schools, so I’m likely wrong.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。我都不觉得你被允许进女生宿舍。不过我对公立学校的规矩不熟，多半是我想错了。

lines.en: : To be fair, I’m not very well versed in them either and I work for one.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我也不太懂那些规矩——而我还给公立学校打工呢。

lines.en: scene toukahair2
: W-What Sensei means to say is that he’s been coming on occasion to...assist with my studies!
lines.zh: : Sensei 的意思是，他偶尔过来……辅导我的功课！

lines.en: : Does this have something to do with his inquiry about your bed at the Christmas gathering?
lines.zh: : 这跟你圣诞聚会上打听她那张床的事有关吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure it-
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定——

lines.en: scene toukahair3
: Wait, you asked my mother about the bed?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 等等，你居然问了我母亲那张床的事？！为什么？！

lines.en: : I already informed you that it’s a standard bed with rapid sleep capabilities! What else do you need to know?!
lines.zh: : 我都告诉过你了，那是张带「快速睡眠」功能的普通床！你还想知道什么？！

lines.en: : I advised him of the same. But now, I’m suddenly intrigued by his need to come all the way over here to aid with your studies.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么跟他说的。可现在，他突然起了兴趣，非要大老远跑来辅导你的功课。

lines.en: : Which subjects is Touka struggling with, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那 Touka 到底哪门功课跟不上？

lines.en: : Uhh...
menu:
Physical Education
lines.zh: 体育

lines.en: : She’s been really struggling when it comes to gym class. She just can’t seem to keep up with the other girls.
lines.zh: : 她最近在体育课上特别吃力。就是跟不上其他女孩。

lines.en: scene toukahair4
: Okay, {i}that{/i} is entirely untrue! I would never struggle keeping up with any of the girls in our class!
lines.zh: : 好，{i}这{/i}完全是瞎编！我怎么可能跟不上我们班的任何女孩！

lines.en: : Save the small one with the auburn hair, but I’m beginning to believe she may have been raised by wolves. She moves far too quickly for a [young]girl.
lines.zh: : 那个红棕色头发的小不点除外——不过我开始怀疑她是被狼养大的。以[未成年]女孩来说，她动作快得离谱。

lines.en: Is {i}that{/i} why Miku never brings up her past?
lines.zh: 所以 Miku 从来不提自己的过去，是{i}这个{/i}原因？

lines.en: Also, this entire scenario is untrue and I don’t know why this particular addition to it is what’s setting Touka off.
lines.zh: 另外，这整个说法都是编的，我不知道为什么偏偏是这一句把 Touka 惹毛了。

lines.en: : You are...tutoring my daughter in physical education?
lines.zh: : 你在……辅导我女儿的体育？

lines.en: : I am.
: You’re not! Tell her it’s for...English!
lines.zh: : 你不是！快告诉她你教的是……英语！

lines.en: : I am here to teach your daughter about physical education and biology.
lines.zh: : 我是来教你女儿体育和生物的。

lines.en: scene toukahair5
: Ugh. Why do I even bother?
lines.zh: : 唉。我干嘛还多费口舌。

lines.en: : I was unaware she was struggling. Touka has always seemed very athletic to me, but I suppose I haven’t paid much attention to those outside of our bubble.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她这么吃力。Touka 在我眼里一向很擅长运动，不过我想，我平时没怎么关注「圈子」之外的人。

lines.en: : Is that really something you can tutor her in {i}here,{/i} though? You don’t require some sort of...gymnasium?
lines.zh: : 可这种课真能在{i}房间里{/i}辅导吗？你不需要……体育馆之类的吗？

lines.en: Economics
lines.zh: 经济学

lines.en: : Touka doesn’t seem to grasp the basic concepts of economics- likely due to her inexposure to the middle class or the true value of money.
lines.zh: : Touka 好像搞不懂经济学的基本概念——多半因为她没接触过中产阶级，也不懂钱的真正价值。

lines.en: scene toukahair4
: Wha- no! That’s not true at all!
lines.zh: : 什——才不是！根本不是那么回事！

lines.en: : Even if I lack the same sort of {i}exposure{/i} as the other girls, I completely understand and appreciate the value of money! Probably even more than most!
lines.zh: : 就算我没其他女孩那样的「{i}接触{/i}」，我也完全理解并懂得钱的价值！说不定比大多数人都懂！

lines.en: : As the heir to the Tsukioka family business, it is absolutely essential that I understand something as {i}basic{/i} as economics.
lines.zh: : 身为月冈家产业的继承人，弄懂经济学这种{i}基础{/i}的东西，是绝对必须的。

lines.en: : You bought a one million yen painting for Makoto on Christmas.
lines.zh: : 你圣诞节给 Makoto 买了一幅一百万日元的画。

lines.en: scene toukahair6
: That’s it? I told you it was okay to spend a little more.
lines.zh: : 就这？我跟你说过可以再多花点的。

lines.en: : Did I go under budget? I will admit that seeing the limit written in USD did confuse me a bit, so I apologize if that is what happened.
lines.zh: : 我花超预算了吗？我承认看到上限是用美元写的有点把我绕晕了，要真是那样我道歉。

lines.en: : In my defense, however, conversion rates are not exactly reliable or even relevant at the moment due to Kumon-mi’s isolation from the rest of the world.
lines.zh: : 不过我得辩解一句：由于公文美与外界隔绝，汇率这东西眼下既不可靠、也基本不适用。

lines.en: : You weren’t under budget. You spent more on that present than Makoto has probably ever even seen before.
lines.zh: : 你没花超。你花在那份礼物上的钱，比 Makoto 这辈子见过的都多。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, how is that bad?
lines.zh: : 那有什么不好的？

lines.en: : It’s bad because it just shows how little you know about money.
lines.zh: : 不好就好在，这说明你对钱一窍不通。

lines.en: : Darling, I had no idea this was such an issue for you. Perhaps we should ask your father to hold off on transitioning until you’re more comfortable with-
lines.zh: : 亲爱的，我都不知道这对你来说是这么大的问题。也许我们该让你父亲先缓一缓「交接」，等你更适应——

lines.en: Animal Husbandry
lines.zh: 畜牧学

lines.en: : Touka has been having a really tough time with our animal husbandry course.
lines.zh: : Touka 最近在畜牧学这门课上特别吃力。

lines.en: scene toukahair6
: Is that true, dear?
lines.zh: : 真的吗，亲爱的？

lines.en: : You’ve always been so good with the horses. I assumed animal husbandry would be a walk in the park for you.
lines.zh: : 你对马一向很在行。我还以为畜牧学对你来说是小菜一碟。

lines.en: : I...was unaware we even had an animal husbandry course.
lines.zh: : 我……都不知道我们还有畜牧学这门课。

lines.en: : See what I mean? This is how far behind she is.
lines.zh: : 瞧见了吧？她都落后到这地步了。

lines.en: scene toukahair7
: Well, that won’t do at all. Everyone knows how important and essential animal husbandry is to the average, everyday Japanese citizen.
lines.zh: : 那可不行。谁都知道，畜牧学对日本普通市民来说有多重要、多不可或缺。

lines.en: : Yup. That is definitely a thing everyone knows.
lines.zh: : 对。这绝对是「谁都知道」的事。

lines.en: : But, you know- if Touka would just stop strangling all of the kittens we bring in for educational purposes, I wouldn’t have to go out of my way and come here to teach her more about proper husbandry.
lines.zh: : 不过，你知道吗——只要 Touka 别再掐死我们为教学而带来的小猫，我也就不用特意跑来教她正确的「畜牧方法」了。

lines.en: scene toukahair8
: Touka! You’ve been strangling defenseless kittens?!
lines.zh: : Touka！你一直在掐死毫无反抗之力的小猫？！

lines.en: : Absolutely not! And, just as I assumed, we don’t have an animal husbandry class at all!
lines.zh: : 绝对没有！而且正如我所料，我们根本没有畜牧学这门课！

lines.en: : Probably!
lines.zh: : 大概吧！

lines.en: : At the very least, there have not been any kittens!
lines.zh: : 至少，从来没有过任何小猫！

lines.en: scene toukahair9
: Oh dear. Then who is it that’s been strangling them?
lines.zh: : 哦天。那是谁在掐死它们？

lines.en: : We have to find out before it’s too late.
lines.zh: : 我们得趁还来得及，把这事查清楚。

lines.en: : But I suppose I shouldn’t get in the way of your husbandry class so Touka can be prepared for when-
lines.zh: : 不过我想，我还是别耽误你们的畜牧课了，好让 Touka 为将来——

lines.en: scene toukahair10
: Mother, no. He is here to tutor me in English.
lines.zh: : 母亲，不是的。他是来辅导我英语的。

lines.en: : {i}Like he always does at this time on this specific day of the week.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就像他每周这个特定的日子、这个时间一直做的那样。{/i}

lines.en: : I have never seen Sensei-
lines.zh: : 我从没见过 Sensei——

lines.en: : {i}Like he always does at this time on this specific day of the week.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就像他每周这个特定的日子、这个时间一直做的那样。{/i}

lines.en: : Touka, you know I’m fluent in English, don’t you? Why haven’t you asked me for assistance?
lines.zh: : Touka，你知道我英语很流利吧？你为什么不来找我帮忙？

lines.en: : The entire kitchen staff can speak it as well. It’s becoming an essential language.
lines.zh: : 整个厨房 staff 也都会说。英语正变成一门必备语言。

lines.en: : The kitchen staff changes monthly, mother. They are not a reliable source of information.
lines.zh: : 厨房 staff 每个月都换，母亲。他们不算可靠的消息来源。

lines.en: : Yes, I agree. I don’t know where your sister picked up that hobby, but your father really needs to do something about it.
lines.zh: : 对，我同意。我不知道你妹妹从哪儿捡来的这个爱好，但你父亲真该管管了。

lines.en: scene toukahair11
: R-Regardless! Sensei is {i}definitely{/i} here to teach me, seeing as there is no other reason for him to ever come to this room!
lines.zh: : 不——管怎么说！Sensei {i}绝对{/i}是来教我的，因为他根本没有任何别的理由来这个房间！

lines.en: : Well, let me say now that I admire his dedication.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我现在就得说，我佩服他的这份敬业。

lines.en: : It takes a special type of person to do something like this out of the kindness of his heart.
lines.zh: : 能纯粹出于好心做这种事的人，可不多见。

lines.en: : What can I say? I’m a pretty great guy.
lines.zh: : 能说什么呢？我就是个挺好的家伙。

lines.en: : And here I was beginning to think that you hadn’t been taking my daughter’s education seriously.
lines.zh: : 而我刚才还在想，你是不是一直没把我女儿的教育当回事。

lines.en: : Oh, {i}what a shame that would be.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}那可就太遗憾了。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
Touka finishes messing around with Yasu’s hair and sends her back over to her side of the room, where she takes a seat and begins staring at the wall in typical Yasu fashion.
lines.zh: Touka 摆弄完 Yasu 的头发，把她打发回她那半边房间。Yasu 坐下，开始以典型的 Yasu 风格盯着墙发呆。

lines.en: Tsubasa proceeds to down the rest of her wine in one gulp without so much as batting an eye- a skill I believe she may have acquired after years of dealing with her youngest daughter.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 则眼都不眨地把剩下的酒一口闷了——我猜这是她多年应付小女儿练出来的本事。

lines.en: She then gestures for me to take a seat on the completely normal bed between her and Touka- who suddenly appears very exhausted for some unknown reason that definitely doesn’t have to do with me.
lines.zh: 然后她示意我坐到那张「完全正常的床」上，夹在她和 Touka 之间——而 Touka 不知为何突然显得很疲惫，那原因绝对跟我无关。

lines.en: scene toukahair12
: Hah...
: Oh, darling. Needing a little extra help when it comes to your education is nothing to be ashamed about.
lines.zh: : 哦，亲爱的，学习上需要点额外帮助，没什么好羞愧的。

lines.en: : Just blame it on your upbringing. It is both accurate {i}and{/i} a reasonable excuse when it comes to explaining your perceived inadequacies.
lines.zh: : 怪你的成长环境就行。这在解释你「表层的不足」时，既属实{i}又{/i}是个站得住脚的借口。

lines.en: : I am not ashamed, Mother. I just wish I had {i}remembered my lessons were going to be tonight{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我没觉得羞愧，母亲。我只是希望自己{i}记得今晚有课{/i}。

lines.en: : Because not only does this interrupt the rare chance for the two of us to spend time together, I look...entirely unprepared to learn.
lines.zh: : 因为，这不仅打断了我们俩难得相处的机会，而且我这副样子……完全没做好「上课」的准备。

lines.en: scene toukahair13
: Oh my- you’re right. How incredibly informal of us.
lines.zh: : 哎呀——你说得对。我们也太不讲究了。

lines.en: : If I had known you were going to come tonight, I would have postponed our monthly slumber party.
lines.zh: : 早知道你们今晚要来，我就把我们每月一次的「睡衣派对」推迟了。

lines.en: : And if I had known this was something you two had been planning, I would have rescheduled Touka’s totally-legitimate English tutoring session.
lines.zh: : 早知道你们俩约好了这个，我就把 Touka 那场「完全正当的英语辅导」改期了。

lines.en: : My, what a lovely offer. I do suppose we’ll take you up on that. Right now.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这提议真好。那我们这就恭敬不如从命。就现在。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t be silly, Touka. As much as I care about our relationship, I also care about you becoming the best person you can be.
lines.zh: : 哦，别傻了，Touka。我虽然在乎我们的母女情，但我也在乎你能否成为最好的自己。

lines.en: : And that person just happens to be fluent in English the same way her mother is.
lines.zh: : 而那个「最好的自己」，恰好跟她母亲一样，英语流利。

lines.en: scene toukahair14
: Hah...
Touka shoots me a glance that I can immediately tell means that I’m going to owe her a favor in the future, but I guess that’s fine.
lines.zh: Touka 朝我使了个眼色，我一眼就看懂那意思是「你以后欠我个人情」——不过没关系。

lines.en: I’m sure that a large part of why she’s helping disguise one of my many casual visits to her dorm room is to just make {i}herself{/i} look good-
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，她帮忙掩饰我无数次的「宿舍探访」，很大部分原因只是想让她{i}自己{/i}好看——

lines.en: But, as a self-centered man who is also made to look good in the process, I can’t help but thank her for that.
lines.zh: 但作为一个同样在此过程中「好看了」的利己主义者，我还是忍不住要谢她。

lines.en: Being indebted to someone isn’t exactly a thing I like, though.
lines.zh: 不过，欠人人情可不是我喜欢的事。

lines.en: So if I can prevent having her attempt to cash in her hook on me before she has an actual opportunity to, I probably should.
lines.zh: 所以，要是能在她真有机会「兑现」我之前，先堵住她这条路，我大概该这么做。

lines.en: : We can have our totally legitimate tutoring session another time, Touka. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我们改天再上那场「完全正当的辅导课」吧，Touka。没关系的。

lines.en: scene toukahair15
: Pardon my asking, but...what exactly is the catch?
lines.zh: : 恕我多嘴，不过……这里面到底有什么「猫腻」？

lines.en: : No catch. Just don’t want to get in the way of something that’s important to you.
lines.zh: : 没猫腻。只是不想耽误对你重要的事。

lines.en: : Okay, but...
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……

lines.en: : What is the catch?
lines.zh: : 到底有什么猫腻？

lines.en: : Am I not allowed to do nice things?
lines.zh: : 我就不能做件好事吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no. Or at least you don’t seem to possess the capability to actually enact any without something in return.
lines.zh: : 不太能。或者说，你好像没那个本事——不图回报就办不成一件好事。

lines.en: : Touka, that is no way to speak to your teacher.
lines.zh: : Touka，不该这么跟你老师说话。

lines.en: : Apologies, Mother.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，母亲。

lines.en: scene toukahair16
: Thank you very much for offering to do that, Sensei. My daughter and I don’t get to spend as much time together as either one of us would like.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你愿意那么做，Sensei。我和我女儿能相处的时间，比我们俩希望的都少。

lines.en: : Well, {i}this{/i} daughter. My other daughter and I spend almost {i}too{/i} much time together. But she is a...special case.
lines.zh: : 是{i}这个{/i}女儿。我另一个女儿跟我待的时间反而{i}太{/i}多了。不过她是个……特例。

lines.en: : Why not spend more than one night per month together if that’s the case? I can’t imagine that’s really enough.
lines.zh: : 既然如此，为什么不每月多聚几晚？我觉得那样都不够。

lines.en: : Especially with Yasu...existing.
lines.zh: : 尤其是有 Yasu……这么个存在。

lines.en: : I quite like Touka’s roommate actually. Her reaction to seeing the manor for the first time was adorable.
lines.zh: : 我其实挺喜欢 Touka 的室友的。她第一次看见大宅时的反应可爱极了。

lines.en: scene toukahair17
: Why has Yasu gotten to see your house but I haven’t?
lines.zh: : 为什么 Yasu 都看过你家了，我却没去过？

lines.en: : Because I don’t believe you’d be able to conduct yourself appropriately if you were to come.
lines.zh: : 因为我不认为你来了能管住自己的言行。

lines.en: : But you think Yasu-
lines.zh: : 可你觉得 Yasu 就——

lines.en: : I said what I said, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我说了什么就是什么，Sensei。

lines.en: : The fact of the matter is, Mother and I {i}can’t{/i} spend more time together. We’re far too busy for that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 事实是，母亲和我就是{i}没法{/i}多待。我们为那种事太忙了。

lines.en: : Are you? Because all you have is school and Tsubasa has been just...I don’t know. Watching your sister, maybe?
lines.zh: : 是吗？你除了上学就没别的了，而 Tsubasa 又一直……我也不知道。在看着你妹妹，也许？

lines.en: scene toukahair18
: Oh, I do much more than that.
lines.zh: : 哦，我做的事可远不止那些。

lines.en: : I spend most of my time overseeing the Tsukioka Foundation's hospitality and real estate branches.
lines.zh: : 我大部分时间都在监管月冈财团旗下的酒店和房地产业务。

lines.en: : I’m sure it sounds boring to you, but I’m actually quite good at it.
lines.zh: : 你肯定觉得听着很无聊，但我其实相当在行。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ll ever understand how your family transitioned from bubble wrap to basically owning the city.
lines.zh: : 我想我永远搞不懂，你家是怎么从「做气泡膜」做到「基本坐拥这座城」的。

lines.en: : Yes, well...the last few years have certainly been very kind to us.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这个嘛……过去几年对我们确实格外眷顾。

lines.en: : When I was younger, Mother and I had much more time to spend together. But with the family becoming a more prominent figure in the city, it’s just not possible anymore.
lines.zh: : 我小的时候，母亲和我有大把时间相处。可随着家族在城里越来越举足轻重，这再也不可能了。

lines.en: scene toukahair19
: Ahh, how lovely it would be to go back, though.
lines.zh: : 啊，要是能回到从前就好了。

lines.en: : All of those summers spent at our vacation homes...the laughs we shared...the joyous ruckus caused by an expensive band of animatronic animals...
lines.zh: : 那些在度假屋度过的夏天……我们共享的欢笑……还有一支昂贵的「机器动物乐队」制造的欢乐喧闹……

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 你说什么玩意儿？

lines.en: : Maybe this summer will be a little different, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，也许今年夏天会有点不一样？

lines.en: : Perhaps the small break in the school year would give me the time to see how you handle your end of the family business, Mother?
lines.zh: : 也许学年里的这个小假期，能给我时间去看看您是怎么打理家族产业这一块儿的，母亲？

lines.en: If there {i}is{/i} a break, that is.
lines.zh: 前提是，{i}真有{/i}假期的话。

lines.en: If I remember correctly, there was a small one for Christmas just before our first party...but I have no idea how summer vacation works or...if that’s even a thing we get.
lines.zh: 我没记错的话，我们第一次派对前、圣诞节那阵有过一个小假……可我完全不知道暑假是怎么回事，也……不知道我们到底有没有暑假。

lines.en: scene toukahair20
: I think that sounds wonderful, dear. But don’t you think your time might be better used experiencing a {i}real{/i} summer vacation for the first time?
lines.zh: : 我觉得那主意很棒，亲爱的。可你不觉得，你的时间拿去体验你人生中第一个{i}真正{/i}的暑假，会更有价值吗？

lines.en: : You finally have the opportunity to do so- and it’s one that neither your father nor myself ever had. I wouldn’t risk losing that if I were in your position.
lines.zh: : 你终于有机会这么做了——而这是你父亲和我都不曾有过的机会。我要是你，不会拿它冒险。

lines.en: scene toukahair21
: But...I don’t really understand what that entails.
lines.zh: : 可是……我不太明白那要怎么做。

lines.en: : I have a hard enough time following what it is the common folk do during normal parts of the year. The idea of a vacation with them is just...not one that I think I’m fully prepared for yet.
lines.zh: : 我连「平民百姓」平常日子里干嘛都搞不太懂。「跟他们一起度假」这个概念……我想我还没完全准备好。

lines.en: : I mean, you did go on the beach trip with everyone recently. Just think of it like that except...the right weather.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你最近不是跟大家一起去海边旅行了吗。就想象成那样，只不过……天气是对的。

lines.en: : If you don’t understand how it works, just {i}ask{/i}, dear. There’s no harm in that.
lines.zh: : 你要是不懂怎么回事，尽管{i}问{/i}，亲爱的。问又不吃亏。

lines.en: : I’m sure your teacher would love to show you how everyone else spends their summer vacations.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，你老师会很乐意带你看看别人都是怎么过暑假的。

lines.en: scene toukahair22
: I would?
lines.zh: : 我会？

lines.en: : Is that...something you’d actually consider, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那……是你真会考虑的事吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You {i}have{/i} shown me the ropes of other aspects of the outside world- as frayed as they may have been.
lines.zh: : 你{i}已经{/i}带我用「残缺不全」的方式见识过外面世界的别的方面了。

lines.en: : If you’d be willing to show me how a standard, commoner summer would look like as well...I’d consider myself greatly indebted to you.
lines.zh: : 要是你也愿意带我看看「标准的平民暑假」是什么样子……那我会觉得自己欠你一个大人情。

lines.en: scene toukahair23
: Well, that {i}does{/i} sound a lot better than me being indebted to you.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那听着{i}可比{/i}我欠你人情强多了。

lines.en: : It would just probably make a little more sense to ask one of your other-
lines.zh: : 不过，找你别的——可能更说得通一点——

lines.en: : I’m going to stop you right there in order to save both my heart and my pride, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我得在这儿打断你，好保全我的心和我的自尊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Good call. Wouldn’t want your mother knowing you don’t have any-
lines.zh: : 明智的选择。你总不想让你妈知道你没有——

lines.en: : Again, I am going to stop you right there.
lines.zh: : 我再说一遍，我要在这儿打断你。

lines.en: : Don’t have any what, Touka? Is it something we can provide you?
lines.zh: : 没有什么，Touka？是我们能给你的东西吗？

lines.en: : Sadly, no. It is not, Mother.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，不是，母亲。

lines.en: scene black
Sensing that it’s time for me to leave, I get off the bed only to be followed up by the Tsukiokas who, when combined, surpass everyone else on this floor put together in terms of breast volume.
lines.zh: 察觉该走了，我从床上起身，身后跟着月冈母女——她俩加在一起，胸围超过了这层楼其余所有人的总和。

lines.en: Does that have anything to do with the matter at hand? No.
lines.zh: 这跟眼下的事有关系吗？没有。

lines.en: But when the two of them stand next to one another, it’s something I can’t help but notice and appreciate.
lines.zh: 可当她俩并肩一站，我就忍不住注意到并欣赏这一点。

lines.en: scene toukahair24
You know, on closer inspection, I think they might win out the combined-floor {i}ass{/i} category as well.
lines.zh: 仔细一看，我觉得她们在「全层{i}臀围{/i}合计」这一项上也能拔得头筹。

lines.en: This family is rich in far too many ways.
lines.zh: 这个家族在太多方面都「富」得很。

lines.en: : Thank you again for allowing Touka and I to spend the rest of the night together. We truly do appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 再次感谢你把今晚剩下的时间留给我和 Touka。我们真的很感激。

lines.en: : It’s a shame about your lesson, but I’m sure the two of you will make up for it soon enough.
lines.zh: : 耽误你的课挺可惜，但我相信你们俩很快会补上的。

lines.en: : Especially with you agreeing to teach her about middle class summers and all.
lines.zh: : 尤其你还答应了教她「中产阶级的夏天」什么的。

lines.en: : Did I agree to that yet? Because I still don’t really think I’m the right person to-
lines.zh: : 我答应了吗？因为我还是觉得我不是教这个的合适人选——

lines.en: : Oh, nonsense. I’m sure you’ll do perfectly fine. Perhaps you can make a field trip out of it?
lines.zh: : 哦，别这么说。我敢肯定你会做得很好。也许你可以把它办成一次「实地考察」？

lines.en: : Right. Because nothing says {i}vacation{/i} like a planned, school-funded educational trip.
lines.zh: : 对。因为没什么比「学校出资、计划好的教育之旅」更像{i}度假{/i}了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind funding it if money is the issue, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，钱要是问题，我也不介意出资。

lines.en: : Not really what I was getting at.
lines.zh: : 我不是这个意思。

lines.en: : Things have been a bit warmer as of late, Sensei. Perhaps you can show me a few things the next time we meet up outside?
lines.zh: : 最近天气转暖了点，Sensei。也许下次我们出去时，你可以带我见识几样东西？

lines.en: : Oh, I’ll show you some things alright.
lines.zh: : 哦，我一定带你「见识几样」东西。

lines.en: : Splendid. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: : 太好了。太感谢了。

lines.en: : What a generous man you are, going to such lengths for my daughter.
lines.zh: : 你真是个慷慨的男人，为我女儿做到这个地步。

lines.en: : I’m pretty good at all things involving length, so to speak.
lines.zh: : 可以说，凡涉及「长」的事，我都很在行。

lines.en: scene toukahair25
: We {i}are{/i} still talking about education, yes?
lines.zh: : 我们还{i}在{/i}聊「教育」，对吧？

lines.en: : Mother! Ew! Don’t say things like that while winking at my teacher!
lines.zh: : 母亲！恶！别一边冲我老师挤眉弄眼一边说那种话！

lines.en: : In fact, don’t wink at him to begin with! It is strange and unpleasant!
lines.zh: : 其实压根就别对他挤眉弄眼！又怪又让人不舒服！

lines.en: scene toukahair26
: Touka, dear. If there’s anything you need in order to make the most of your summer vacation training course, don’t hesitate to let me know.
lines.zh: : Touka，亲爱的。要是你需要什么来充分利用你的「暑假特训课」，尽管告诉我。

lines.en: : I won’t, but...I think it’s less of a training course and more of an...orientation?
lines.zh: : 我不会客气的，不过……我觉得那与其说是「特训课」，不如说是……「入门导览」？

lines.en: : I don’t think I’d call it either of those two things.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这两个叫法都不合适。

lines.en: Especially when I still have no idea what I can even show Touka when her biggest summer memories involve an...animatronic animal band?
lines.zh: 尤其当我到现在都不知道能带 Touka 见识什么——她关于夏天最深刻的回忆，居然是一支……机器动物乐队？

lines.en: scene toukahair27
: I suppose we’ll be seeing you around, then? If there won’t be any lecturing done tonight, we should probably be getting back to Yasu’s hair.
lines.zh: : 那我们回头见？既然今晚不上课了，我们该回去接着弄 Yasu 的头发了。

lines.en: : It is...quite unkempt.
lines.zh: : 是挺……乱的。

lines.en: : Sure. But if she converts either one of you two, I don’t know how much time I’ll be able to spend with you anymore.
lines.zh: : 行。不过她要是把你们俩哪一个「传教」成功了，我都不知道还能有多少时间跟你们待在一起了。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry about that. I’ve taught my mother the “boop” technique and we’ve come up with a rule where we poke Yasu every time she begins to rant.
lines.zh: : 哦，那个不用担心。我教过我母亲「戳一戳」大法，我们立了条规矩：Yasu 一开始念叨，我们就戳她。

lines.en: : I’m very excited to try this on my youngest daughter as well. Though I can’t imagine it being nearly as effective.
lines.zh: : 我已经迫不及待想在我小女儿身上试试这招了。不过我想效果不会那么好。

lines.en: : Well, have fun poking Yasu and being related or something. I’ll get out of your way now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那你们就好好「戳 Yasu、享受天伦之乐」什么的。我就不打扰了。

lines.en: : Thank you again for postponing our totally legitimate English lesson, Sensei. It was a very nice thing to-
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你推迟我们那场「完全正当的英语课」，Sensei。你真是个好人——

lines.en: : You know I don’t actually buy that. Right, dear?
lines.zh: : 你知道我根本不信那套。对吧，亲爱的？

lines.en: : {i}Run.{/i}
scene black
I quickly exit Touka’s bedroom and force myself back into the state of mind where Tsubasa doesn’t believe I just show up to her daughter’s room for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: 我飞快退出 Touka 的卧室，逼自己回到「Tsubasa 不认为我无缘无故出现在她女儿房间」的心境。

lines.en: That aside, though, I’ll have to start thinking about summer-related activities to teach Touka about soon.
lines.zh: 抛开这个不谈，我得很快开始想些能教给 Touka 的「夏日活动」了。

lines.en: That might sound easy to you, but I’d like to use this opportunity to remind you that I only visit a select few locations every week- and I’m sure she’s already seen at least most of them.
lines.zh: 听着可能很容易，但我要借这个机会提醒你：我每周只去固定的几个地方——而她多半已经见过其中大半了。

lines.en: Either way, I should be thankful that unknowingly interrupting another rare mother-daughter get together did not end in tragedy or suspicion.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我该庆幸：无意中打断又一场难得的母女相聚，没酿成悲剧，也没招来怀疑。

lines.en: At least...not any suspicion that was outwardly revealed to me.
lines.zh: 至少……没有招来什么摆到明面上给我看的怀疑。

lines.en: I have no idea what Tsubasa will choose to believe in her own mind, but...
lines.zh: 我不知道 Tsubasa 心里会怎么想，但……

lines.en: I guess I can wishfully think it works out in my favor.
lines.zh: 我想我只能一厢情愿地盼它对我有利了。

lines.en: Especially since that’s all I ever really do anyway.
lines.zh: 反正我向来也就只会这样。

lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度提升到了 [touka_love]!{/i}
